levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «آبائه» is a collective with no name: unnamed (rule 8)
«(رضي الله عنه)», «(عليهم السلام)» and the numbers (3), (4) are not in the surfaces
«أبي عبد الله الصادق» follows «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
the Prophet's act is the saying, and the Prophet is not a link (rule 12)
